title: Patch 8: vollständige Living-Dungeon-Expedition, Ebene 1 (Build 4.3.0-c.6.6.31)
brief: Start a new campaign as a new player would. Create a Mage with the skills Flame Lance and Blink. Go into the city you start near, register at the Adventurers' Guild (pay the fee the clerk names) and read the board for your rank. Take a contract that sends you into a dungeon, best one that asks you to clear level 1 there, and register it at the front desk. Travel to that dungeon, pass its gate (pay the entry fee if the gate names one) and go onto level 1. Fight the foes the dungeon puts in your way. When you find a group of foes that has not noticed you, attack one of them openly, without sneaking or hiding first, and see whether the whole group fights. Defeat the level's guardian, clear the level, and when the contract slip shows it is done, go back to the Guild hall and turn it in.
brief_extra: This run tests a whole Living Dungeon expedition. A contract outside any dungeon does not count for it. If the board offers no dungeon contract, write that in your observations and read the board again the next morning (rest at an inn or in the hall). If there is still none, go to a dungeon anyway: the test of the dungeon itself still counts. Rest or heal when your HP run low: a dead Alaric ends the test.

milestones.goal: Create the character: the Base Class Mage, then the two skills Flame Lance and Blink.
Go into the city to the Adventurers' Guild and register as a member, paying the fee the clerk names.

Read the Guild's board and take a contract that sends you into a dungeon, best one that asks you to clear level 1 there; register it at the front desk. If the board has none, read it again the next morning.
Travel to that dungeon, pass its gate (pay the entry fee if the gate names one) and go onto level 1.
Explore level 1 and meet the foes the dungeon has there.
Fight a group of two or more of the dungeon's foes and watch whether they all fight you together.

Find a group of the dungeon's foes that has not noticed you and attack one of them openly, without sneaking or hiding first. Watch whether the whole group takes part in the fight from its start and each acts on its own turn.
Find level 1's guardian and defeat it.
Clear level 1: defeat what the level still holds until the System says it is cleared.
Do what the contract asks until the contract slip shows it is done (READY).
Leave the dungeon, go back to the Guild hall and turn the contract in at the front desk.

focus: Patch 8: does the dungeon's gate ask for its fee once, and let you in once it is paid?
Patch 8: when you attack one member of an unaware group openly, does the fight list every member of the group from its start, and do the others act on their own turns?
Patch 8: does the level say when it is cleared, and does the contract slip agree?
